units.source_text: 突然他发狂似的大叫起来。

en.t: Suddenly he began shouting like a madman.

units.source_text: 他不知说什么好，那叫喊成不了句子。

en.t: He did not know what to say, and the shouting would not form words.

units.source_text: 只是发出声音而已，他用足全身的力气拼命地叫喊。

en.t: It was only a sound coming out; he screamed desperately with all the strength in his body.

units.source_text: 好像这个噩梦就会退却，

en.t: As if this nightmare would simply draw back,

units.source_text: 睁开眼睛，为带来了料想不到的失态道歉，

en.t: open its eyes, apologize for having brought about such an unexpected disgrace,

units.source_text: 把他从沙坑底部抛出去。

en.t: and throw him out from the bottom of the sand pit.

units.source_text: 叫喊不出的声音又细又弱。

en.t: The voice that could not quite become a shout was thin and weak.

units.source_text: 声音半途被沙吸入，被风吹散，所以根本就吃不准那叫喊声究竟能送到哪里。

en.t: The sound was swallowed by the sand midway and scattered by the wind, so there was no telling how far the cry could reach.
